spans.s: छिन्नद्वैध a. whose doubts have been destroyed.
छिन्ननास्य a. having the nose-string cut or broken.

छिन्न॑पक्ष^1 a. having the wings torn off.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: print hard to read. cf mw, pw. pakza = wing.
छिन्नमूल a. cut up by the root.
छिन्नसंशय a. whose doubts are dispelled.
छिन्नाभ्र n. a cloud torn asunder.
